evals.prompt: Add wshobson/agents to Claude Code for a Kubernetes + Python backend project without bloating context.
evals.expected_outcome: Registers wshobson/agents marketplace and installs only python-development, kubernetes-operations, and security-scanning instead of all 73 plugins.
assertions: Explicitly warns against bulk-installing all 73 plugins

evals.prompt: Export a wshobson/agents plugin for OpenCode or Codex using the upstream tooling.
evals.expected_outcome: Points to Makefile targets and tools/adapters in a clean upstream checkout before copying artifacts.
assertions: Stages and inspects generated plugin files before installing

evals.prompt: Run /office-hours and /qa with a persistent headless browser daemon.
assertions: Routes /office-hours and /qa browser workflows to gstack
